items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Interviewer mentions Edwin Franco Goldman as editor of the book the interviewee used; interviewee confirms using the book but shows no personal interaction.

ctx.x: See this book there? This book just cost me three dollars. For that book. I didn't go all through that book, but I went through the first method, you see? Yeah. Uh-huh. I went halfway of that, you see?
You went halfway through Auburn's Complete Conservatory Method for Trumpet and Cornette. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Or so forth, so forth. Edited by Edwin Franco Goldman and Walter M. M as in mother, Smith.
